item.title: Learner Guide
item.description:
This guide takes you through one complete learning journey in the Layer5 Academy: you find a learning path, enroll, work through it, pass its final assessment, and receive your credential. Along the way you learn how the Academy tracks your progress and how its tests are scored, so you know what to expect from any content you take next.

You need a Layer5 Cloud account to enroll. Browsing the catalog needs no account.

item.title: Platform Development Guide
item.description:
This guide walks you through the Layer5 Academy platform’s multi-repository architecture. You will learn the role of each core component and master the practical workflows for theme development, local testing, and end-to-end validation with Layer5 Cloud.

The Multi-Repository Model 🔗

The Layer5 Academy platform is built on a “separation of concerns” architecture. Instead of a single monolithic repository, we use a multi-repository model where content, style, and build configurations are managed independently. This approach keeps the system modular, simplifies maintenance, and allows teams to work on different parts of the platform concurrently.

item.title: Instructor Console
item.description:
The Instructor Console reports on your organization’s Academy content and learners. It answers three questions: how many people are learning, how far they get, and which assessments stop them. The console is also where you register new content and manage who can access it.

Availability and access 🔗

Academy Theoretical Learning A comprehensive learning management system for creators and instructors on how to build, manage, and extend educational content like learning paths, challenges, and certifications. -Not included -Not included -Not included ✓Included
Academy Practical Learning An inclusive, collaborative, hands-on learning environment for students. -Not included -Not included -Not included ✓Included

Opening the console requires the View Academy Metrics permission in the selected organization. Without it, the console shows a missing-permission message that names the permission.
